# Daily Dashboard V0.5.1

## Outlook-style calendar and fitted working hours

- The calendar now mirrors the quiet dark Outlook/Teams presentation, with square date headers, category-tinted meetings and a clear current-day accent.
- The complete 9 AM–6 PM workday fits the available widget height. Afternoon events no longer require scrolling, including in half-height layouts.
- Events are assigned subcolumns using their actual rendered bounds. This prevents short, adjacent and simultaneous meetings from covering one another after the timeline is compressed. Free subcolumns are reclaimed where possible.
- All-day events remain individually visible. A Full day/outside-hours control provides access to meetings outside working hours.

## Music layout

- Added an album-art toggle in the widget and under Settings → Music. The preference is saved with the existing dashboard settings.
- Hiding artwork removes its reserved space and expands the track information and media controls.
- Compact widgets retain square thumbnails when artwork is shown. Idle and disconnected Spotify states no longer reserve an empty artwork area.

## Display checks

- All six enabled widgets are checked at half, tall, wide and full sizes across 19 display/scaling configurations: 456 widget/size cases, plus artwork and empty-state checks.
- Calendar stress fixtures include overlapping, adjacent, short, all-day and 6 PM meetings; checks verify presence, date-column alignment, bounds, hit targets and non-overlap.
- Improved compact aircraft-map controls and very narrow weather headers found during these checks.

Install the attached Windows setup executable over the previous version after closing the app. The application identifier and settings-file location are unchanged. Native upgrade behaviour on a physical Windows machine remains for your installation test.
